notes: Part numbers 16535 / 16535A. 48x front-panel 10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+ (802.3af/at) copper ports. Rear panel: 4x unpopulated 1GbE SFP ports upgradable to 10GbE SFP+ via ExtremeXOS license (2 are combo with 2 of the RJ45 copper-combo ports, 2 are non-combo dedicated SFP+); 2x 1GbE RJ45 copper-combo ports upgradable to 10GbE (share physical port with 2 of the SFP+ cage). Two of the rear SFP+ ports can alternatively be configured as stacking ports via CLI (stacking not available on all variants). AC inlet is IEC 60320 C14 (mates with a C13 cord); Extreme ships the unit without a power cord and sells country-specific C13 cords separately, consistent with a standard IEC inlet rather than a captive cord. Redundant Power Supply (RPS) port on rear is a proprietary Extreme RPS connector (not a standard connector in the given list); mapped to dc-barrel as the closest generic id — treat with low confidence on connector id specifically. Grades: RJ45 access ports are 10/100/1000 (eth-1g best case, no 2.5G/5G/10G on the 48 access ports); rear SFP+/combo ports are 1G by default, field-upgradable to 10G (eth-10g) via ExtremeXOS Edge license — graded here as eth-1g (shipped/default state) per port with note that eth-10g is available via license upgrade using appropriate SFP+ optics. Console and USB port speeds/grades not applicable (RS232-equivalent console over RJ45, USB 2.0 not in USB grade list scope beyond usb-2.0 tag omitted since exact USB spec version on connector not confirmed as bandwidth-relevant here it is set). DC-powered variant (X440-G2-48t-10GE4-DC) exists separately and is NOT this model (this is the AC PoE+ model). No HDMI/AV connectors — this is a pure Ethernet access switch bundled into an AV rack for network infrastructure.
